**Migration done.** 36 calls across 12 files now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

All files pass `node --check`. No tests exist in the repo.

I left `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js` alone. Its header says edits are lost on upgrade. Two `db.query` calls remain there.

| Package | Files |
|---|---|
| `accounts` | 3 |
| `support`, `orders`, `billing`, `catalog` | 2 each |
| `analytics` | 1 |

Next: pin or fork `legacy-orm` before the driver drops `query`.
